newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

A team of Bangladeshi microbiologists and clinicians have standardised a blood culture method for children to detect typhoid germs within 24 hours, facilitating quick treatment of patients without delay.
Securitymen on Friday arrested four armed tribal shantibahini rebels in the hilly district of Bandarbans.
The Prime Minister of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam Vo Van Kiet arrives in Dhaka on Sunday on a two-day officials visit to Bangladesh.

President of the Federation of Bangladesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FBCCI), Abdullah Yusuf Harun, on Sunday urged the government to announce a clear policy statement on bringing undeclared income into the economy.
The government is likely to impose a visa ban on the Bangladeshi nationals for avoiding illegal immigration there.
Bangladesh expressed its deep concern and deplored the recent Israeli decision to build new Jewish settlements in East Jerusalem.
The governemnt has launched a Tk 2.34 billion rehabilitation programme for settlement of the people displaced due to the construction of the bridge on the river Jamuna.
Forest and Environment Minister Syeda Sajeda Chowdhury on Saturday said that a bill protecting women's rights would be placed in the parliament soon.
